rationale: The loss label requires that the shipment cannot be located or that tracing stopped without finding it, and here the trace closed because the package was found. Damage and delay both remain reported, and the contract's order places damage before delay.

state.document_text: PACKING LIST AND ORIGIN DECLARATION, ref PL-EX-3308, shipper Tallow Fabrication Ltd. (tallowfab.example), consignee Brindle Retail Co. (brindle.example). Carton 1 of 3: 40 steel brackets model SB-9, gross 18 kg, 60x40x30 cm; carton 2 of 3: 40 steel brackets model SB-9, gross 18 kg, 60x40x30 cm; carton 3 of 3: 12 mounting kits MK-2, gross 6 kg, 40x30x20 cm. rationale: The text itemizes cartons with contents, counts, weights, and dimensions and states no prices, currency, or value, so the packing_list rule applies. It also carries an exporter's origin attestation, but when a text combines elements of more than one listed type the contract's order selects packing_list before certificate_of_origin.

state.receiving_note: PO-EX-7720 from Kestrel Supply (kestrel.example): 18 of the 20 cartons on the BOL received, and the driver confirms two cartons were not on the truck. Outer wrap on several cartons is scuffed but every carton opened has intact contents fit to put away. Carton 11 is labeled SKU KS-310 but contains KS-330 per the inner pack labels; held on the dock for the supervisor.

rationale: Scuffed wrap with contents the note calls intact and fit to put away does not meet the damage criterion, which requires units or cartons unfit to put away. Of the two discrepancies the note does report, a shortage and a mislabeled carton, the contract's order places mislabel before shortage.

state.claim_narrative: Claim CLM-EX-518 for shipment TRK-EX-9026, six crates of glass panels from Ferrow Glassworks (ferrow.example) to Lantern Interiors (lantern.example). On arrival three crates contained shattered panels. The inspector notes that one panel showed a hairline crack that predates pickup and that the shipper's foam spacers were thinner than spec, but concludes that the main cause of the loss is the carrier's forklift striking the crates during cross-dock transfer, evidenced by fork punctures through the crate sides. We are filing against the carrier on that basis.

rationale: The narrative names a pre-existing crack, thin packaging spacers, and a forklift strike, but explicitly presents the carrier's forklift strike as the main cause. The contract selects the cause the narrative presents as primary before any fallback ordering, so the ordering that would otherwise favor pre_existing does not apply.

state.supplier_message: Re PO-EX-4410, line 2 (VX-200 controller, qty 40): we have closed this line on our side because the VX-200 has been discontinued by the manufacturer and will not be supplied. The successor model VX-210 is in stock at the same unit price and we would be glad to ship it right away; please raise a new PO for it if that suits. Lines 1 and 3 are unaffected and ship Thursday as confirmed.

rationale: The message states that a line is closed and will not be fulfilled, and the contract selects cancellation even when the supplier suggests reordering something else. The successor-model offer therefore does not make it a substitution_proposal, and the shipment confirmation for other lines does not make it other_update.

state.breach_note: Order 5520 missed the next-day commitment. Our pick wave finished after the carrier cutoff, so the parcel was tendered a day late. The carrier delivered on time from its pickup.

rationale: The note attributes the miss to late picking and a missed cutoff on the shipper's side before handover.

state.breach_note: SVC-EX-1193, pallet to Corvin Assembly (corvin.example), committed Tuesday, delivered Wednesday. Our warehouse tendered the pallet after the carrier's 16:00 Friday cutoff, so it did not leave until Monday's linehaul; that truck then missed its connection at the Marlow hub, which pushed delivery to Wednesday. No weather or road issues were reported and the consignee was open and ready to receive.

rationale: The note gives a chain of causes whose first link, as the note states it, is the late tender past the carrier's cutoff, which the contract categorizes as origin processing. The missed hub connection is a downstream link rather than the first cause, and the note explicitly rules out external and recipient-side causes.
